fee_notes: Lump sum payment is $25,000. Installment plan totals $35,000 ($10,000 due at signing, $25,000 balance in 60 monthly payments of $416.67 starting month 13). Veterans receive 10% discount on non-financed portion. Franchise Fee Forgiveness Program may refund $15,000 or waive financed portion. Apprentice Program and Enterprise Program allow $0 initial fee. In 2025, fees ranged from $0 to $35,000.
raw_excerpt: The initial franchise fee for an Agency (the "Initial Fee") ranges from $25,000 to $35,000. You may pay the entire Initial Fee in a lump sum, in which case you will pay $25,000. If you, instead, opt to pay the Initial Fee in monthly installments, then the total Initial Fee will equal $35,000.
